doc.title: Eddie Miller and Pete Fountain Interview, 1970-01-09

title: Tony Almerico and the Junior Dixieland Band
summary: A caller and Pete recall the Parisian Room and Pete's teenage Junior Dixieland Band.

story.theme_name: First paying gigs: getting started as a young professional
story.community_name: First paid gigs: pay, bands and young beginnings

blocks.x: Thank you for your call. I think we can get one more in. Go ahead, please. Hello. Yes, sir. Yes, sir.
Yeah. Gonzalez, where's me going? Listen, we've got a discussion here. Do you remember Almarico's band? Yeah, Tony Almarico.
Right. We were just talking about him, about the Parisian room.
Yeah, but did you ever play for him when he had his band upstairs,

when he was up to play Blockwood on Royal Street? Right, that's the Parisian room. Yeah. I used to play there. We played there with a group called the Junior Dixieland Band. Right. When we won a Horace Height show.
If I am mistaken, I think Gerard used to play that group.
Right. Gerard used to play out there.
